import asyncio
from fastmcp.server import FastMCP
from fastmcp.client import Client, FastMCPTransport
from fastmcp.resources import ResourceContent


server = FastMCP(name="example-server")


@server.resource("data://config")
def config_resource():
    return ResourceContent(
        content='{"setting": "value", "enabled": true}',
        mime_type="application/json"
    )


async def main():
    transport = FastMCPTransport(server)
    client = Client(transport)
    
    async with client:
        result = await client.read_resource("data://config")
        print(f"Resource contents: {result.contents}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio
from fastmcp.server import FastMCP
from fastmcp.client import Client, FastMCPTransport
from fastmcp.resources import ResourceContent


server = FastMCP(name="example-server")


@server.resource("data://config")
def config_resource():
    return ResourceContent(
        content='{"setting": "value", "enabled": true}',
        mime_type="application/json"
    )


async def main():
    transport = FastMCPTransport(server)
    client = Client(transport)
    
    async with client:
        result = await client.read_resource("data://config")
        print(f"Resource contents: {result.contents}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
